Derived pipeline: capture → pinned prettier 3.9.6 (module API, default options, single pass verified idempotent — never the CLI: it respects .gitignore and can silently echo its input) → readable/<name>.pretty.js|css per captured JS/CSS file (capture-root-relative name, dirs flattened with __; every pretty provably NOT byte-identical to its capture source) → statement-aligned slices src/<name>-NN.js of the app code (top-level declaration boundaries only, ~250-350 line windows; oversized single declarations stay whole) with an exact 2-line provenance header. Every slice parses standalone under `node --input-type=module --check -` and round-trips byte-exact to its recorded readable line range. Vendor rule — wholeFile sections, never sliced: the three.js r186 regions merged into app.js (the core module + its export table, the WebGLRenderer module, the addon bundle with CopyShader/EffectComposer/MeshoptSimplifier, the BufferGeometryUtils fragment, the GLTFLoader module) — content-anchored, guarded and asserted; and the platform's PWA worker __mb/app/worker.js (platform machinery). Stylesheet rule — style.css is wholeFile. Inline scan: index.html (3 inline platform shims), shell.html and shell-index.html (5 inline scripts + 2 inline styles each) → readable/<doc>-inline-N.pretty.{js,css} twins recorded in readable/index-inline-map.json with byte ranges + sha256. Identifiers in src/ are the bundle's own minified names — the rename campaign (PLAN §5) is recorded as an open task in README.md, not claimed here. Capture bytes are untouched by everything above; re-cut with `node tools/derive.mjs` after any capture refresh. `node tools/audit.js` is the gate.
